### About Me

I am a political scientist studying American and Korean politics. My research interests include legislative politics (Congress), elections, and public opinion.

I received my M.A. in Political Science from Yonsei University in August 2026.

So far, my research has been published in *[Legislative Studies Quarterly](https://doi.org/10.1111/lsq.70072)*, as well as in journals in Korean.
